[Item 1: Business Trip Travel Expenses - Hangzhou to Beijing]
Step 1: Check — Whether Business Trip Report Form is properly completed and signed. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Whether the transportation class (first-class train seating) is appropriate for the personnel rank. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Whether accommodation standard (RMB 600/night) complies with bureau-director-level limit for Beijing. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Compute — Meal subsidy eligibility: 3 calendar days × RMB 100/day = RMB 300. Result: 300.
Step 5: Check — Whether meal subsidy amount (RMB 300) matches the regional standard. Result: PASS.
Step 6: Check — Whether city transportation (RMB 180 against receipts) is supported by valid invoices and within reasonable limits. Result: PASS.
Step 7: Check — Whether there are any special circumstances requiring explanation (no external unit sharing, no remote area issues, no self-driving). Result: PASS.
Step 8: Conclusion — All travel expense requirements are satisfied. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Office Supplies Purchase - Stationery, Newspapers, and Magazines]
Step 1: Check — Whether the items qualify as office expenses (stationery, newspapers, magazines). Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Whether the amount is below the fixed asset threshold (RMB 1,000). Result: PASS (not specified but stated to not reach threshold).
Step 3: Check — Whether the items fall within Asset Management Office review scope. Result: PASS (explicitly stated not within scope).
Step 4: Check — Whether supporting materials include goods list and invoice from seller. Result: PASS.
Step 5: Check — Whether there are any online shopping records requiring additional documentation. Result: PASS (none involved).
Step 6: Conclusion — All office expense requirements are satisfied. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 1: National Teaching Forum Conference Expenses]
Step 1: Check — The event qualifies as a domestic business conference under Rule 9. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Required supporting materials are present (notice, agenda, budget, detailed list, sign‑in sheet, invoices, contract). Result: PASS.
Step 3: Compute — Allowable total under research fund quota: 750 RMB per person per day × 100 participants × 2 days = 150,000 RMB. Result: 150000.
Step 4: Compute — Claimed total: lodging 500×100×2 = 100,000; meals 150×100×2 = 30,000; other 110×100×2 = 22,000; total = 152,000 RMB. Result: 152000.
Step 5: Compute — Overage: 152,000 – 150,000 = 2,000 RMB (other expenses exceed 100 RMB per person per day). Result: 2000.
Step 6: Check — No advance payment, no prohibited items, not >50% Shanghai participants, single batch reimbursement. Result: PASS.
Step 7: Conclusion — The conference expense exceeds the comprehensive quota; only the amount within the quota (150,000 RMB) is reimbursable, the 2,000 RMB overage must be disallowed. Result: Partially Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Printing and Office Supplies for Conference Handbook]
Step 1: Check — The expense is for printing conference supplies and office stationery, falling under Rule 6. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — The total invoice amount exceeds RMB 1,000, requiring a detailed list per Rule 6(5). Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — The invoices were artificially split into multiple invoices issued in the same period to avoid the threshold, violating Rule 6(5) prohibition. Result: FAIL.
Step 4: Check — The required inventory review confirmation form (Rule 6(2)) is not mentioned as provided. Result: FAIL.
Step 5: Check — No contract for single payment ≥ RMB 30,000 is required, but splitting indicates intent to circumvent thresholds. Result: PASS.
Step 6: Conclusion — The expense violates Rule 6(5) and Rule 3 requirements, and falls on the negative list (Rule 4). Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Training Program Main Expenses (lodging, meals, venue/materials, other)]
Step 1: Check — Is the 'Fudan University Detailed List of Training Expense Expenditures' submitted?. Result: FAIL.
Step 2: Check — Are trainee list and contact information provided?. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Are invoices from training service provider submitted?. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — Is written approval for increased standard submitted?. Result: PASS.
Step 5: Compute — Calculate the bureau-director-level per day standard: 400 + 150 + 70 + 30 = RMB 650/day. Result: 650.
Step 6: Compute — Calculate standard total for 15 days: 650 × 15 = RMB 9,750. Result: 9750.
Step 7: Compute — Compare actual cost (RMB 13,200) vs standard (RMB 9,750): excess = 13,200 - 9,750 = RMB 3,450. Result: 3450.
Step 8: Check — Is there approval for the increased standard?. Result: PASS (written approval attached).
Step 9: Conclusion — Missing required document (Detailed List of Training Expense Expenditures) is a critical deficiency per Rule 10(3). Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Instructor Lecture Fees]
Step 1: Check — Is the lecture fee amount within the allowable range?. Result: PASS (RMB 1,800 is within RMB 1,000/hour × 4 hours = RMB 4,000 max for senior title).
Step 2: Check — Are there invoices or proof of payment for lecture fees?. Result: PASS (invoices provided by training service provider).
Step 3: Check — Is the 'Fudan University Detailed List of Training Expense Expenditures' submitted?. Result: FAIL.
Step 4: Conclusion — Missing required document per Rule 10(3), though lecture fee amount itself is compliant. Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 3: Instructor's Personal Expenses (lodging, meals, transportation)]
Step 1: Check — Is instructor's lodging (RMB 500) within bureau-director-level accommodation standard?. Result: PASS (500 < 650 limit for Beijing, or 400 per day for bureau-director level).
Step 2: Check — Is instructor's meals (RMB 150) within standard?. Result: PASS (150 equals the per-day meal allowance for bureau-director level).
Step 3: Check — Is intercity transportation (RMB 400) supported by invoice?. Result: PASS (invoice submitted).
Step 4: Check — Is the 'Fudan University Detailed List of Training Expense Expenditures' submitted?. Result: FAIL.
Step 5: Conclusion — Missing required document per Rule 10(3), though individual expense amounts are compliant. Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 4: Professor Li's Business Trip to Beijing]
Step 1: Check — Is the 'Fudan University Business Trip Report Form' attached?. Result: PASS (form attached).
Step 2: Check — Is there approval since unit head traveled personally?. Result: PASS (signed by other relevant leaders).
Step 3: Check — Is intercity transportation appropriate for the personnel level?. Result: PASS (first-class train is appropriate for bureau-director-level personnel).
Step 4: Compute — Calculate accommodation limit for 2 nights in Beijing: 650 × 2 = RMB 1,300. Result: 1300.
Step 5: Check — Is lodging cost within limit? Actual: 600 × 2 = RMB 1,200. Result: PASS (1,200 < 1,300).
Step 6: Compute — Calculate standard meal allowance: 100 × 3 days = RMB 300. Result: 300.
Step 7: Check — Is meal subsidy claimed within standard?. Result: PASS (300 equals standard).
Step 8: Compute — Calculate lump-sum local transportation: 80 × 3 days = RMB 240. Result: 240.
Step 9: Check — Is local transportation claimed within standard?. Result: PASS (240 equals standard).
Step 10: Check — Are both intercity transportation and lodging invoices submitted?. Result: PASS (both invoices submitted).
Step 11: Check — Was there self-driving, car rental, or external unit bearing expenses?. Result: PASS (none of these apply).
Step 12: Conclusion — All requirements met; appropriate documentation provided; amounts within standards. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Family Visit - Intercity Transportation]
Step 1: Check — Whether this is a valid family visit trip for a married employee visiting spouse. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Whether only intercity transportation is claimed (no local transportation). Result: PASS - case states only intercity transportation included.
Step 3: Check — Whether required form is present (Faculty and Staff Family Visit Application and Approval Form). Result: PASS - form provided with departmental approval and personnel department seal.
Step 4: Check — Whether claimed amount equals actual transportation expense. Result: PASS - claimed RMB 950 equals actual transportation expense of RMB 950.
Step 5: Check — Whether airplane fare is controlled to equivalent train fare. Result: PASS - case states claimed amount was controlled according to equivalent train fare.
Step 6: Conclusion — All requirements for family visit travel reimbursement are satisfied. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Business Trip - Intercity Transportation (First-class Train)]
Step 1: Check — Whether Business Trip Report Form is properly completed with required signatures and seal. Result: PASS - form completed, signed by unit head, affixed with department official seal.
Step 2: Check — Whether traveler is the unit head (to determine if counter-signature required). Result: PASS - traveler is not the unit head, so only unit head signature needed.
Step 3: Check — Whether trip is charged to research project funds. Result: PASS - case states charged to research project funds.
Step 4: Check — Transportation class for research project principal investigator. Result: PASS - Rule 7 allows PI to choose appropriate means within budget; first-class train is acceptable for PI.
Step 5: Conclusion — Intercity transportation reimbursement meets all requirements. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 3: Business Trip - Lodging (2 nights at RMB 700/night)]
Step 1: Check — Whether lodging invoice is attached. Result: PASS - lodging invoice attached.
Step 2: Check — Traveler's rank to determine accommodation standard. Result: Other personnel - traveled in first-class train (not highest level) but not at bureau-director level; however for research project, PI can choose appropriate means.
Step 3: Compute — Beijing accommodation limit for Other Personnel. Result: FAIL - Claimed RMB 700 exceeds limit of RMB 600.
Step 4: Compute — Excess amount per night. Result: RMB 700 - RMB 600 = RMB 100 per night.
Step 5: Compute — Total overclaim for 2 nights. Result: RMB 100 × 2 = RMB 200.
Step 6: Conclusion — Lodging exceeds the accommodation limit; only RMB 1,200 (2×600) is reimbursable instead of RMB 1,400. Result: Partially Reimbursable.

[Item 4: Business Trip - Meal Subsidy (RMB 300)]
Step 1: Check — Whether meal subsidy is supported by inter-city transportation and accommodation invoices. Result: PASS - both transportation and accommodation invoices are attached.
Step 2: Check — Whether there is cost sharing by external unit. Result: PASS - no cost sharing by external unit.
Step 3: Compute — Trip duration in calendar days. Result: 3 calendar days (itinerary covers 3 calendar days with 2 nights).
Step 4: Compute — Standard meal allowance for 3 days in Beijing. Result: RMB 100 × 3 = RMB 300.
Step 5: Compute — Claimed meal subsidy. Result: RMB 300.
Step 6: Conclusion — Meal subsidy of RMB 300 is within the standard and fully reimbursable. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 5: Business Trip - City Transportation (RMB 180 against receipts)]
Step 1: Check — Whether local transportation receipts are provided. Result: PASS - RMB 180 reimbursed against receipts.
Step 2: Check — Whether there is cost sharing by external unit for transportation. Result: PASS - no external cost sharing.
Step 3: Check — Whether trip is self-driving or rental vehicle. Result: PASS - no self-driving or car rental; this applies only to inter-city travel, not local transportation.
Step 4: Compute — Standard lump-sum local transportation for 3 days. Result: RMB 80 × 3 = RMB 240.
Step 5: Compute — Claimed amount against receipts. Result: RMB 180 (less than the lump-sum standard of RMB 240).
Step 6: Conclusion — Local transportation of RMB 180 is supported by receipts and within allowable limits. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Overseas Travel Expenses - Singapore Conference]
Step 1: Check — Whether the Approval Document for Overseas Travel is provided. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Whether the overseas expense statement is provided with required components (conference registration fee, overseas living expenses, personal incidental allowance, intercity transportation). Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Whether transportation class matches the personnel standard (division-level personnel, economy-class airfare). Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — Whether payment methods comply with requirements (official card for airfare, bank transfer for lodging). Result: PASS.
Step 5: Check — Whether reimbursement was completed in one batch after returning to China. Result: PASS.
Step 6: Check — Whether air ticket and boarding pass are attached. Result: PASS.
Step 7: Check — Whether materials were reviewed and signed by the Exit and Entry Service Center of the Foreign Affairs Office. Result: PASS.
Step 8: Check — Whether foreign currency was properly selected in the Online Reservation Reimbursement system for conversion to RMB. Result: PASS.
Step 9: Conclusion — All requirements under Rule 8 are satisfied. The absence of formal invoices is compensated by the review and signature from the Exit and Entry Service Center, which Rule 8(2) explicitly accepts as sufficient for items like air tickets, visa fees, and insurance fees. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 2: On-campus Academic Event Expenses]
Step 1: Check — Whether the event falls under conference expenses and research project funds. Result: PASS - confirmed as domestic business conference charged to research project funds.
Step 2: Check — Whether comprehensive quota standards are met (accommodation 500 + meals 150 + other expenses 100 = 750 RMB/person/day max). Result: PASS - reported 480+150+100=730 RMB/person/day, within the 750 limit.
Step 3: Check — Whether required supporting materials are complete (notice, agenda, budget form, detailed expense list, sign-in sheet, invoices, supporting documents, electronic settlement, contract). Result: PASS - all materials stated as complete in the case.
Step 4: Check — Whether reimbursement was in one batch through the same channel. Result: PASS - confirmed one batch reimbursement with no advance payment.
Step 5: Check — Whether the conference duration complies with Rule 9(7) limit of 2 days for domestic business conferences. Result: FAIL - the event was reported as lasting 3 days, exceeding the 2-day limit specified in Rule 9(7).
Step 6: Conclusion — While the expense amounts are within the comprehensive quota and all required materials are present, the 3-day duration violates Rule 9(7) which explicitly states domestic business conferences shall not exceed 2 days. This is a policy violation that affects the reimbursability. Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Doctoral Dissertation Defense Remuneration]
Step 1: Check — Number of reviewers: 5 reviewers reported,是否符合 Rule 13 规定的 5-8 人范围. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Reviewer fee per person: RMB 300,是否符合 Rule 13 规定的 RMB 300-500 范围. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Number of defense committee members: 5 members reported,是否符合 Rule 13 规定的 5-7 人范围. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — Defense committee member fee per person: RMB 300,是否符合 Rule 13 规定的 RMB 300-500 范围. Result: PASS.
Step 5: Check — Defense secretary: 1 person at RMB 150,是否符合 Rule 13 规定的 RMB 150 标准. Result: PASS.
Step 6: Compute — Total defense remuneration: (5 × 300) + (5 × 300) + (1 × 150) = 1500 + 1500 + 150. Result: 3150.
Step 7: Conclusion — All fee parameters fall within the standard ranges specified in Rule 13. All required materials appear to be complete. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Special Lecture Fee for Bureau-Director-Level Lecturer]
Step 1: Check — Lecturer rank: bureau-director-level person or equivalent,确认是否符合资深专业技术人员标准. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Class hours: 4 class hours for half-day,是否符合 Rule 13 规定的半天最多 4 课时. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Fee per class hour: RMB 900,是否超过 Rule 13 规定的 RMB 1,000 上限. Result: PASS (RMB 900 < RMB 1,000).
Step 4: Check — Whether lecture fee is after-tax: Case states 'not specifically stated as being reported on an after-tax basis',确认是否符合 Rule 13 规定的'课后税'要求. Result: FAIL.
Step 5: Compute — Total lecture fee: 4 hours × RMB 900 = RMB 3,600. Result: 3600.
Step 6: Conclusion — While the fee amount and hours are within standards, Rule 13 explicitly requires lecture fees to be 'after tax' (课后税). The case explicitly states there is no indication the fee was reported on an after-tax basis. This is a missing critical requirement. Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 3: Conference Expenses for 2-Day Domestic Conference]
Step 1: Check — Conference type: domestic conference, 2 days, approximately 100 participants,确认为国内会议. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Funding source: non-research project funds,应适用中央和国家机关会议费管理办法标准. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Comprehensive quota standard for Category III/IV domestic conferences: RMB 340 + RMB 130 + RMB 80 = RMB 550 per person per day,对照标准核算. Result: FAIL (Reported RMB 750 exceeds RMB 550).
Step 4: Check — Conference duration: 2 days,是否符合国内管理会议不超过1天的规定. Result: FAIL (Management conference should not exceed 1 day, but case states 2 days).
Step 5: Check — Additional items outside comprehensive quota: venue rental RMB 200/person/day, equipment rental RMB 100/person/day, cold buffet RMB 220/occasion, staff lodging/meals RMB 450/person/day, volunteer subsidies RMB 100/person/day, interpretation RMB 6,000/interpreter/day, translation RMB 200/1,000 words, vehicle RMB 1,500/bus/day,核对附加费用是否符合标准. Result: .
Step 6: Check — Staff ratio: 10 staff (5 resident),是否超过正式代表人数的10%，且驻会人员不超过会议工作人员的50%. Result: PASS (10/100 = 10%, 5/10 = 50%).
Step 7: Check — Staff lodging/meals: RMB 450/person/day,是否符合RMB 450标准. Result: PASS.
Step 8: Check — Cold buffet: RMB 220/occasion,对照标准不超过RMB 220. Result: PASS (at standard).
Step 9: Check — Equipment rental: RMB 100/person/day,对照标准RMB 100. Result: PASS (at standard).
Step 10: Check — Interpretation (non-UN language): RMB 6,000/interpreter/day,对照标准RMB 6,000. Result: PASS (at standard).
Step 11: Conclusion — Two violations found: (1) Comprehensive quota of RMB 750 exceeds the Category III/IV standard of RMB 550, exceeding by RMB 200 per person per day; (2) Conference duration of 2 days exceeds the 1-day limit for domestic management conferences. The base accommodation/meals/other expenses within the comprehensive quota are not fully reimbursable. Result: Partially Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Waterproofing Renovation Project Final Settlement Payment]
Step 1: Check — Whether the original approval form is attached with required seals. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Whether the approval form bears both the Capital Construction Office seal and the Project Review Seal of the Renovation Management Office. Result: PASS.

Step 4: Check — Whether this is a final settlement payment (not initial payment) with all final settlement documents. Result: PASS.
Step 5: Check — Whether Fudan University Construction Project Cost Review Opinion is attached with cost review company seal and Capital Construction Office Review Process seal. Result: PASS.
Step 6: Check — Whether Fudan University Construction Project Final Settlement Audit Filing Form is attached with engineering management department signature/seal and Audit Office receipt/comments. Result: PASS.
Step 7: Check — Whether payment amount follows contract and project progress (no excess or advance payment). Result: PASS.
Step 8: Check — Whether final settlement amount is based on verified total settlement price and does not exceed contract price. Result: PASS.
Step 9: Conclusion — All requirements for engineering final settlement payment have been met. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

Step 2: Check — Whether receipt bears signature of department head. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Whether warranty period has expired. Result: PASS.

Step 1: Check — Whether the Construction Project Cost Review Opinion specifies the amount to be included in university's construction cost. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Whether the claimed amount matches the portion to be borne by the university. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Whether the portion to be borne by the construction contractor is separately listed. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — Whether a copy of the cost review fee invoice issued in contractor's name is provided. Result: PASS.
Step 5: Conclusion — All requirements for cost review fee reimbursement have been met. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Laboratory Equipment Parts (Purchased Materials)]
Step 1: Check — Is the item a fixed asset, intangible asset, book, or application software?. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Is the 'Fudan University Purchased Inventory Confirmation Form (Based on Review Results)' included?. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Are the required original invoices and signatures (project principal investigator and handling staff) present?. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — Does the amount exceed the single-payment threshold requiring a contract (RMB 30,000)?. Result: PASS (threshold not reached).
Step 5: Conclusion — All conditions for purchased materials reimbursement are satisfied. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Travel Expenses (Business Trip)]
Step 1: Check — Is the 'Fudan University Business Trip Report Form' completed, signed by the unit head, and affixed with the official seal?. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Is the intercity transportation (first-class train seat) permissible for the traveler's rank (professor, bureau‑director‑level)?. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Are the lodging expenses (RMB 600 per night) within the accommodation limit for the traveler's rank in Beijing?. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — Is the meal subsidy amount (RMB 300) consistent with the daily allowance (RMB 100 × 3 days)?. Result: PASS.
Step 5: Check — Are local transportation receipts provided and does the amount (RMB 180) comply with the limit (RMB 80 per day)?. Result: PASS.
Step 6: Check — Was a special explanation approved and signed by the project leader provided for the car rental, fuel, and tolls (RMB 200)?. Result: FAIL.
Step 7: Compute — Amount to be excluded due to missing special explanation. Result: 200.
Step 8: Conclusion — Travel expense meets general travel requirements, but the car rental portion lacks the required explanation and must be excluded. Result: Partially Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Domestic Official Hospitality for Peer University Visit]
Step 1: Check — Whether financial invoices are provided. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Whether official letter from visiting institution is provided. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Whether 'Fudan University Domestic Official Hospitality List' is provided. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — Whether 'Fudan University Domestic Official Hospitality Approval Form' is provided. Result: FAIL.
Step 5: Check — Whether visitor count complies with accompanying personnel limits (Rule 18(3): ≤3 for ≤10 guests). Result: PASS.
Step 6: Check — Whether working meal standard complies with Rule 18(3) (≤RMB 100 per person per day for boxed meal/buffet). Result: PASS.
Step 7: Check — Whether formal banquet standard complies with Rule 18(3) (≤RMB 150 per person per occasion). Result: PASS.
Step 8: Check — Whether accompanying staff meal standard complies with Rule 18(3) (≤RMB 50 per person). Result: PASS.
Step 9: Check — Whether lodging was properly handled (no suites for provincial/ministerial level, standard rooms only). Result: PASS.
Step 10: Check — Whether transportation was arranged via centralized transportation. Result: PASS.
Step 11: Conclusion — Missing essential document 'Fudan University Domestic Official Hospitality Approval Form' required by Rule 18(1). Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Special Conference Expenses (Research Project Funds)]
Step 1: Check — Whether conference is charged to research project funds. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Conference duration (Rule 9(7): domestic business conferences shall not exceed 2 days). Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Participant count and whether conference was held outside Shanghai when >50% from local institutions (Rule 9(8)). Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — Lodging standard against research project fund quota (Rule 9(1): accommodation ≤RMB 500 per person per day for domestic business conferences). Result: PASS.
Step 5: Check — Meal standard against research project fund quota (Rule 9(1): meals ≤RMB 150 per person per day for domestic business conferences). Result: PASS.
Step 6: Check — Other expenses against research project fund quota (Rule 9(1): other expenses ≤RMB 100 per person per day for domestic business conferences). Result: PASS.
Step 7: Check — Total comprehensive quota (Rule 9(1): total ≤RMB 750 per person per day for domestic business conferences). Result: PASS.
Step 8: Check — Whether all required supporting documents are present (conference notice, agenda, budget form, detailed expense list, sign-in sheet, invoices, electronic settlement, entrustment agreement). Result: PASS.
Step 9: Check — Whether reimbursement was made in a single consolidated batch. Result: PASS.
Step 10: Check — Whether there was advance payment. Result: PASS.
Step 11: Check — Whether foreign guests attended (Rule 9(6): domestic conferences with foreign guests require Foreign Affairs Office approval). Result: PASS.
Step 12: Conclusion — All requirements met: conference expenses comply with research project fund standards and all required materials are complete. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Large Centrifuge Maintenance Expenses]
Step 1: Check — Whether the maintenance was applied through Asset Management Office system. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Whether the Fixed Asset Maintenance Application Form was printed and signed. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Whether the form bore signatures of relevant personnel and unit seal. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — Whether original invoice for maintenance service was attached. Result: PASS.
Step 5: Conclusion — All requirements under Rule 17 have been satisfied. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Office Supplies for Maintenance Ledger Recording]
Step 1: Check — Whether the items are routine office supplies below fixed asset threshold. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Whether the items fall within Asset Management Office review scope. Result: FAIL - Case explicitly states items did not fall within review scope.
Step 3: Check — Whether goods list from seller was provided with invoice. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — Whether online shopping transaction record is required. Result: FAIL - No online shopping record exists, but this is acceptable since goods list was provided for non-reviewed items.
Step 5: Check — Whether materials involve books and materials requiring special registration. Result: FAIL - Case states no books/materials involved, and newspapers/magazines here are office reading materials not requiring library registration.
Step 6: Conclusion — Office supplies meet Rule 6 requirements for reimbursement. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Overseas Expert Visitor Reception Expenses]
Step 1: Check — Whether foreign affairs filing was completed. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Whether 'Fudan University Overseas Expert Work Expense Accounting Report' was submitted with proper signatures. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Whether reception list includes guests' institutions, names, and purposes. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — Accommodation standard: four-star hotel for 'other ranks' guests (not vice-ministerial or above). Result: PASS - For non-vice-ministerial level guests, hotels no higher than four-star are permitted per Appendix 3 standards..
Step 5: Check — Routine meal expenses: RMB 320 per person per day. Result: PASS - Within the RMB 300 per person per day standard for 'Other personnel' in Appendix 3..
Step 6: Check — Banquet expenses: RMB 280 per person per occasion. Result: PASS - Within the RMB 300 per person occasion limit for bureau-director level or below per Appendix 3..
Step 7: Check — Gift expenses: RMB 180 per person per occasion. Result: PASS - Within the RMB 200 per person per occasion limit for bureau-director level per Appendix 3..
Step 8: Check — Staff meal allowance subsidy: RMB 50 per person per occasion. Result: PASS - Matches the meal-delay subsidy standard of RMB 50 per person per occasion in Appendix 3..
Step 9: Check — City transportation arrangement matched guests' rank. Result: PASS - Transportation for 'Other personnel' should be economy-class airfare, second-class ship cabin, and soft-seat rail per Appendix 3..
Step 10: Check — Accompanying staff ratio (4 guests, 4 accompanying staff). Result: PASS - For 4 guests (10 or fewer), accompanying staff does not exceed 3; however with 4 guests and 4 accompanying staff, ratio is 1:1 which is acceptable for small groups..
Step 11: Conclusion — All visitor reception expense items meet the standards specified in Rule 19 and Appendix 3. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Beijing Business Trip Expenses]
Step 1: Check — Whether 'Fudan University Business Trip Report Form' was attached. Result: FAIL - The case explicitly states the Business Trip Report Form was not attached..
Step 2: Check — Whether intercity transportation and lodging invoices are provided. Result: PASS - Both intercity transportation invoice and lodging invoice are included..
Step 3: Check — Funding source: research project funds. Result: PASS - The case states this was charged to research project funds..
Step 4: Check — Intercity transportation: first-class train seating. Result: FAIL - Cannot verify compliance without knowing traveler's rank/eligibility. For 'Other personnel' under Rule 7, only train hard seat, hard sleeper, second-class soft seat, second-class seat on high-speed rail/EMU, third-class ship cabin, and economy class airfare are reimbursable. First-class seating exceeds standard..
Step 5: Check — Lodging: 2 nights at RMB 600 per night = RMB 1,200 total. Result: PENDING - Need to verify against Appendix 1 accommodation limits for Beijing. For 'Other personnel' in Beijing, the limit is RMB 500 per person per day. For 2 nights, maximum would be RMB 1,000. Actual RMB 1,200 exceeds the limit by RMB 200..
Step 6: Check — Meal subsidy: RMB 300. Result: FAIL - According to Rule 7(8), meal allowance is RMB 100 per person per day in other regions (not Xinjiang/Qinghai/Tibet). For a 2-night trip, maximum should be RMB 200 (2 days). RMB 300 exceeds the standard by RMB 100..
Step 7: Check — City transportation expenses: RMB 180 on actual basis. Result: PASS - City transportation can be reimbursed against invoices within budget limit per Rule 7(9)..
Step 8: Conclusion — Missing required Business Trip Report Form is a critical material deficiency. Additional issues: first-class seating may exceed standards, lodging exceeds Beijing limit for 'Other personnel', and meal subsidy exceeds daily limits. Result: Not Reimbursable.
